list.name: contributor
list.label: Contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1

list.name: team
list.query:
SELECT __text, __value FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(wt.team_name, NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(wt.team_name, NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = r.contributor
UNION SELECT '(unassigned)', '(unassigned)'
) options ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

list.name: board
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM boards ORDER BY name
list.label: Issue board

options.content:
From everyone who commits to the people delivering tracked work with assistance — where they drop off

Every stage counts people, and each stage is a subset of the one before, so the fall between two bars is a real conversion rate rather than two unrelated numbers. Stage five — agent lines survived to the commit — is the strongest evidence the tool has; stage six needs the tracker key in the commit message. The drop-off list names who is stuck where, which is where a rollout acts.

panels.title: Six stages, each a subset of the last
panels.description: People at each stage in range. Stage one is everyone who committed; each later stage is the people from the stage before who also did the next thing. Read the bars top to bottom as a funnel; the table beside gives the conversion between them.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
ppl0 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(*) commits, SUM(c.status='assisted') assisted, SUM(c.status='assisted' AND c.method='intersected') intersected
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY person, team),
sess AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) person, COUNT(*) n FROM whodunit_sessions s
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
  WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person),
iss AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) n
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY person),
ppl AS (
  SELECT ppl0.*, COALESCE(sess.n,0) sessions, COALESCE(iss.n,0) issues
  FROM ppl0 LEFT JOIN sess ON sess.person = ppl0.person LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.person = ppl0.person)
SELECT s.stage AS metric, s.n AS value FROM (
  SELECT '1 · committed in range' stage, 1 o, COUNT(*) n FROM ppl
  UNION ALL SELECT '2 · opened an agent session', 2, COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE sessions > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT '3 · shipped an assisted commit', 3, COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE assisted > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT '4 · reached five assisted commits', 4, COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE assisted >= 5
  UNION ALL SELECT '5 · agent lines survived to the commit', 5, COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE intersected > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT '6 · closed a tracked issue with assistance', 6, COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE issues > 0
) s ORDER BY s.o

panels.title: Conversion between stages
panels.description: Each stage as a share of everyone and as a share of the stage before it. The second column is the one to act on: the biggest fall between adjacent stages is where the rollout is losing people.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
ppl0 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(*) commits, SUM(c.status='assisted') assisted, SUM(c.status='assisted' AND c.method='intersected') intersected
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY person, team),
sess AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) person, COUNT(*) n FROM whodunit_sessions s
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
  WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person),
iss AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) n
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY person),
ppl AS (
  SELECT ppl0.*, COALESCE(sess.n,0) sessions, COALESCE(iss.n,0) issues
  FROM ppl0 LEFT JOIN sess ON sess.person = ppl0.person LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.person = ppl0.person),
st AS (
  SELECT 1 o, 'committed in range' stage, COUNT(*) n FROM ppl
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'opened an agent session', COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE sessions > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'shipped an assisted commit', COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE assisted > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'reached five assisted commits', COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE assisted >= 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'agent lines survived to the commit', COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE intersected > 0
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'closed a tracked issue with assistance', COUNT(*) FROM ppl WHERE issues > 0)
SELECT a.o AS `#`, a.stage AS `Stage`, a.n AS `People`,
       ROUND(100*a.n/NULLIF((SELECT n FROM st WHERE o=1),0),0) AS `Of everyone %`,
       ROUND(100*a.n/NULLIF(b.n,0),0) AS `Of previous stage %`
FROM st a LEFT JOIN st b ON b.o = a.o - 1 ORDER BY a.o

panels.title: Per team, and who is stuck where
The funnel per team
panels.description: People at each stage, per team. Two teams with the same adoption share can be at very different stages — one with everyone at three, one with half at five and half at one.

WITH 
ppl0 AS (

  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY person, team),
sess AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) person, COUNT(*) n FROM whodunit_sessions s
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
  WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person),
iss AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) n
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY person),
ppl AS (
  SELECT ppl0.*, COALESCE(sess.n,0) sessions, COALESCE(iss.n,0) issues
  FROM ppl0 LEFT JOIN sess ON sess.person = ppl0.person LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.person = ppl0.person)
SELECT team AS `Team`, COUNT(*) AS `Committed`, SUM(sessions > 0) AS `Session`, SUM(assisted > 0) AS `Assisted commit`,
       SUM(assisted >= 5) AS `Five+`, SUM(intersected > 0) AS `Lines survived`, SUM(issues > 0) AS `Issue closed`
FROM ppl GROUP BY team ORDER BY `Committed` DESC

panels.title: Drop-off — who is stuck, and at which stage
panels.description: Everyone who has not reached the last stage, with the first stage they failed to pass. Ordered earliest stage first, most active first within it — the people at the top are the ones a conversation moves furthest. Says where, not why.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
ppl0 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') team,
         COUNT(*) commits, SUM(c.status='assisted') assisted, SUM(c.status='assisted' AND c.method='intersected') intersected
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
    LEFT JOIN whodunit_teams wt ON wt.contributor = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wt.team_name, t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY person, team),
sess AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) person, COUNT(*) n FROM whodunit_sessions s
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
  WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY person),
iss AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) person, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) n
  FROM issues i JOIN issue_commits ic ON ic.issue_id = i.id JOIN whodunit_commits c ON c.commit_sha = ic.commit_sha
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
  WHERE i.status='DONE' AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$' AND c.status='assisted' AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) GROUP BY person),
ppl AS (
  SELECT ppl0.*, COALESCE(sess.n,0) sessions, COALESCE(iss.n,0) issues
  FROM ppl0 LEFT JOIN sess ON sess.person = ppl0.person LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.person = ppl0.person)
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1) AS `Person`, team AS `Team`,
       CASE WHEN sessions = 0 THEN 'never opened a session'
            WHEN assisted = 0 THEN 'sessions, no assisted commit'
            WHEN assisted < 5 THEN 'under five assisted commits'
            WHEN intersected = 0 THEN 'assisted, but no lines survived'
            ELSE 'no tracked issue closed with assistance' END AS `Stuck at`,
       commits AS `Commits`, sessions AS `Sessions`, assisted AS `Assisted`
FROM ppl WHERE issues = 0 ORDER BY FIELD(`Stuck at`,'never opened a session','sessions, no assisted commit','under five assisted commits','assisted, but no lines survived','no tracked issue closed with assistance'), commits DESC

panels.title: Stage 4 · Cycle time — assisted vs not

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN ai = 1 THEN 'AI-assisted' ELSE 'not assisted' END AS `group`,
       ROUND(AVG(ltm)/60, 1) AS `hours`
FROM (
  SELECT i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes AS ltm,
         COALESCE(MAX(w.status = 'assisted'), 0) AS ai
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  LEFT JOIN issue_commits gc ON gc.issue_id = i.id
  LEFT JOIN whodunit_commits w ON w.commit_sha = gc.commit_sha
  WHERE w.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR w.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  bi.board_id = '$board'
    AND i.lead_time_minutes IS NOT NULL
    AND i.issue_key REGEXP '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$'
  GROUP BY i.issue_key, i.lead_time_minutes
) t GROUP BY ai

defaults.noValue: no commits cite this board’s issue keys

panels.description:
Median PR cycle time, split by whether the work was assisted.

**Not a controlled comparison.** An agent is reached for on some kinds of work and not others, so part of any gap measures which work was assigned rather than what the agent did to it. Read it as a difference between two populations, not as an effect.

panels.title: Stage 5 · Rework rate, assisted

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.purpose = 'fix' AND c.status = 'assisted')
  / NULLIF(SUM(c.status = 'assisted'), 0), 1) AS v
FROM whodunit_commits c
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND  ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}')
  AND  ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')

panels.description:
Share of assisted commits labelled as fixes — a rework proxy.

**Not a defect rate.** `purpose` comes from Conventional Commit prefixes and path heuristics, so it measures what commits were labelled, not what broke.

**Read the banded version on the delivery dashboard before concluding anything.** Unbanded, assisted work looks better than unassisted (28.4% against 33.3%); split by change size that reverses in the middle band. The single figure here is a size-mix artefact and is shown as an entry point, not an answer.

panels.title: Habitual use (WAU / MAU)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_sessions s
   WHERE s.last_seen >= (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 7*86400) * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR s.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')) * 100.0
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whodunit_sessions s
   WHERE s.last_seen >= (UNIX_TIMESTAMP() - 30*86400) * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR s.contributor = '${contributor:raw}')), 0), 0) AS v

panels.description:
Weekly actives over monthly actives — whether use is habitual or occasional.

A high ratio means the people who use it use it regularly. It says nothing about how many people that is, which is stage 1.

panels.title: Stage 2 · Engagement — how deep, not how many

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN s.mcp_calls > 0 OR s.distinct_tools >= 5 THEN 'agentic — MCP or many tools'
         WHEN s.tool_calls >= 50 THEN 'multi-file work'
         WHEN s.tool_calls >= 10 THEN 'wrote code'
         WHEN s.tool_calls > 0   THEN 'light edits'
         ELSE 'conversation only — no edits'
       END AS `intensity`,
       COUNT(*) AS `sessions`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
WHERE s.last_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000 AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY `intensity` ORDER BY `sessions` DESC

panels.description:
Sessions bucketed by what actually happened in them, from conversation-only up to agentic work using MCP or many tools.

Depth rather than count, deliberately: ten sessions that produced nothing and one that rewrote a subsystem are not the same adoption, and a session count treats them identically.

options.content: Read with care. Someone at stage one may be working in a repository the tool is not installed in. Stage six counts only issues whose key was in a commit message; a team that does not write keys sits at stage five whatever it delivers. Filters apply to every panel. Cycle time and rework are kept from the original and carry its caveats.
